hero.title: About the Madrasa
hero.subtitle: Three decades of teaching, memorising and living the Book of Allah.

story.title: Founded on trust in Allah
paragraphs: The greatest favour of Allah upon mankind is that He revealed the Quran to His beloved Prophet Muhammad ﷺ for the guidance and well-being of humanity. Allah Himself promised to preserve it, and He made its recitation, and the learning of its rules of Tajweed, a means of preserving it. Learning and teaching the Quran is therefore a source of immense blessing.

Feeling this importance and this need, and moved by deep religious zeal, Khadim-ul-Quran Hafiz Mohammed Abdul Ghani Sahab (R.A) – with very limited resources but complete reliance on Allah – laid the foundation of Madrasa Arabia Tahfeezul Quranil Kareem in Tadban, Hyderabad in 1994.

Allah blessed his early struggle. Through his tireless, day-and-night efforts, the special attention of scholars and the kind support of the community, the madrasa continued to progress by the grace and generosity of Allah. Seeing the growing need, a dedicated section for girls was established under the name Madrasatut Tayyibaat.
Through his continuous efforts to keep the educational standard high, with special care for religious upbringing, the number of students increased day by day.

today.title: A growing garden of the Quran
today.text: Today the madrasa has more than 600 students, served by over 55 skilled teachers and staff. By the grace of Allah, more than 1800 boys and girls have been blessed with the treasure of Hifz, and thousands of boys and girls have learned Nazira Quran with Tajweed. Graduates of the madrasa include the children of well-known personalities of the city.

memorial.name: Hafiz Mohammed Abdul Ghani Sahab
memorial.title: Khadim-ul-Quran · Founder
memorial.text: He devoted his entire life to the service of the Quran, illuminating the hearts of countless boys and girls with the Book of Allah. On 17 Muharram 1447 AH (13 July 2025) he departed from this world, leaving behind this great institution as a lasting legacy of knowledge. May Allah fill his grave with light.
memorial.innaTranslation: Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return.

hero.title: Departments
hero.subtitle: Seven departments working together to nurture Huffaz with knowledge, understanding and good character.

hifz.title: Hifz
hifz.summary: Memorisation of the Quran with Tajweed under expert Huffaz.
hifz.description: The central department of the madrasa. Under the supervision of expert Huffaz, boys and girls memorise the Holy Quran with correct pronunciation and full attention to the rules of Tajweed. After completing Hifz, every student must complete 25 full revisions (daur) so that the memorisation becomes firm and lasting.

nazira.title: Nazira
nazira.summary: Noorani Qaida, Nazira Quran, Urdu, English and Math.
nazira.description: Students learn Noorani Qaida, Nazira Quran, Urdu, English and Mathematics, together with practical training: the method of Salah, memorising Ahadith, and the Sunnah etiquette of eating, drinking and sleeping, along with other daily Islamic manners.

diniyat.title: Diniyat
diniyat.summary: Essential Islamic rulings; Imamat and Khitabat training.
diniyat.description: Essential rulings on the pillars of Islam and on situations of daily life are taught from authentic books. Huffaz are also taught and trained in Imamat (leading prayer) and Khitabat (delivering sermons).

parttime.title: Part-time Quran Classes
parttime.summary: Girls: Asr to Maghrib · Boys: Maghrib to Isha.
parttime.description: For students attending school, Quran classes are held in the evening – for girls from Asr to Maghrib, and for boys from Maghrib to Isha.

arabic.title: Arabic
arabic.description: Alongside Hifz, boys and girls are taught the translation of the Quran. This newly introduced programme has proved very successful: children become blessed not only with memorising the Quran but also with understanding it.

oratory.title: Speech & Oratory
oratory.description: To develop the ability to speak, students regularly practise delivering speeches on various religious topics, so that they can express what is in their hearts clearly and beautifully.

tazkiyah.title: Tas-heeh & Tazkiyah
tazkiyah.description: Respecting their status and position, separate Tas-heeh (recitation correction) sessions are arranged for the teachers, apart from the students. Gatherings of knowledge and spiritual reform (Tazkiyah) are also held, so that knowledge, practice and teaching methods keep improving.

intro.title: Relying on Allah – and on you
paragraphs: To keep its system of education and administration running well, the madrasa relies upon Allah, and on the following means: the generous support of well-wishers of the Ummah, and reasonable fees from students who are able to pay.

However, a large number of students pay less than half the fee, which creates considerable difficulty in running the educational system. There are also many deserving students who can pay no fee at all and have no sponsor.
intro.appeal: Well-wishers are requested to take responsibility for such students. It will be a provision for the Hereafter for you, and a great help to the madrasa.

needs.title: Projects that cannot wait
needs.subtitle: With the steadily growing number of students, the needs of the madrasa keep increasing. These are the most important and immediate ones.

floor.title: Additional floor on the building
floor.description: An additional floor is urgently needed on the 3-storey building so that classrooms can be built for English and other subjects. As per the engineer’s estimate at ₹1,500 per sq. ft., the total cost is ₹75 lakh.

wiring.title: Complete electrical rewiring
wiring.description: The existing wiring on all three floors is more than 25 years old and has become weak in many places. New wiring is urgently needed for everyone’s safety.

sound.title: New sound system
sound.description: For educational and administrative work, spiritual gatherings and other programmes, the current sound system is insufficient. A new system is needed.

generator.title: Generator with installation
generator.description: Power cuts and severe summer heat make classes very hard – especially for girls studying in hijab and burqa – and cut off water for wudu. A generator strong enough for the borewell is needed.

borewell.title: New borewell
borewell.description: The madrasa’s old borewells have dried up. With so many students there is a great need for water, so a large new borewell is urgently required.
